papers.title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
papers.abstract: Extends multimodal agents from static images to continuous video streams with dense spatiotemporal grounding and open-web exploration, achieving 64.0% accuracy.

papers.title: LLaDA MoE v2: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: Characterizes scaling behavior of Mixture-of-Experts diffusion language models and trains a 30B-A3B model approaching Qwen3 performance on knowledge, reasoning, and coding.

papers.title: ContinualSkillBench: Can LLM Agents Truly Evolve Their Capabilities?
papers.abstract: Dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning across five domains, examining whether LLM agents effectively consolidate experience into transferable skills.

papers.title: Are the Financial Reasoning from LLMs Credible? A Real World Test over Long-Horizon Statements
papers.abstract: Evaluates LLM financial reasoning over uncropped financial statements up to 32K tokens, revealing knowledge bottleneck and structural bottleneck vulnerabilities in reasoning.

papers.title: Decoding Children's Gait Behavior
papers.abstract: New dataset of 1,100+ high-frame-rate video sequences for fine-grained analysis of pediatric gait behaviors aged 3-17 years for clinical diagnosis applications.

papers.title: MiniWorld: Democratizing the Training of Video World Models from Scratch
papers.abstract: Reproducible framework for training streaming video world models from scratch using block-causal Video Diffusion Transformer within days on single 8-GPU server.

papers.title: When Agents Learn to Be You: Benchmarking Privacy Leakage, Impersonation Risk, and Defenses in Persona Skills
papers.abstract: End-to-end benchmark measuring privacy leakage and behavioral impersonation risks in persona-skill pipelines with 7,500 dialogue traces from 50 profiles.

papers.title: Push-Wiper: Toward General-Purpose Robotic Cleaning across Varied Stains and Surfaces with Segmented Pushing Trajectories
papers.abstract: Robotic cleaning framework using segmented pushing trajectories with Diffusion Policy achieving up to 130% higher cleaning scores with zero-shot generalization.

papers.title: RestoreKV: Recovering Full-Cache Behavior Under Aggressive Query-Agnostic KV Cache Eviction
papers.abstract: Parameter-efficient approach complementing KV cache eviction selection with learned restoration, improving compression-induced degradation across four backbones.

papers.title: PosterMELD: Multi-Agent Paper-to-Poster Generation for Controllable Design Diversity with Editable Print-Ready Outputs
papers.abstract: Template-conditioned multi-agent pipeline converting papers to editable posters achieving 81.3% print-ready rate with native editability at mean cost of $0.38 per request.

cc_updates.body: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions and their subagents being able to run destructive git commands against the main checkout; isolation now applies to file edits and Bash in every session type. Fixed PreToolUse auto-allow hooks bypassing tool restrictions in background agent tasks (summaries, compaction, renames). Fixed /usage-credits on Team and Enterprise showing already sent a usage credit request for members whose earlier request was dismissed. Fixed the startup connectivity check hanging and then failing behind an HTTPS proxy.

[VSCode] Added Focus view: a chat-menu toggle that hides tool activity behind an expandable per-turn summary with a live running-tool indicator, toggled with Ctrl+Alt+F. Added mode: mask for sandbox credential files on Linux and WSL. Added warnings to claude plugin validate when a marketplace or plugin name would be rejected by Claude Desktop managed marketplace sync.
